plain: Not keeping one's word or duty; disloyal

webster.text: Without belief in the revealed truths of religion; unbelieving.

more.text: Not believing; not giving credit to.
Not adhering to allegiance or duty; disloyal; perfidious; treacherous; as a faithless subject.
Not true to a master or employer; neglectful; as a faithless servant.

example.quote: Shall we not be stigmatized as a faithless, unworthy people, if each member of the Union may, with impunity, violate the engagements entered into by the federal government.?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, South Carolina House of Representatives (debate on calling the convention), Gen. CHARLES COTESWORTH, January 17, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
